name: Corsair: Pirate Open World
summary: Step into a living open world where the ocean is yours to conquer. Take the wheel of your own ship, feel the waves roll beneath the hull, and set course for adventure, plunder, and glory. Whether you're raiding coastal forts, dueling rival ships in thunderous broadside battles, or diving for sunken treasure, every voyage is your story to write.
